text.tspan: 本周 Benchmark 变化趋势

text.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
text.tspan: 1. 本周 Benchmark 正从最终答案与任务通过率，转向行为充分性、执行证据、动态需求和完整交付

text.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
text.tspan: 2. Req2Test-Bench 与 Co-Design Bench 用突变杀伤和反证机制识别虚假通过

text.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
text.tspan: 3. DynaRev 把执行中的需求变化纳入环境

text.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
text.tspan: 4. EmbodiedLab、TreasuryQA 与 Visual Commission Bench 则将证据采集、真实数据摩擦和多阶段资产交付放进同一评测链路
